evidence.claim: Quest title is 78849 'Ninja: Silence is Golden... and Deadly' (quest_title, Blackspore tag).

78851 is a quest_dialog tagged to this quest (Lakeshore) and is a teacher-style greeting ('You must be Ty's new protege... Let's get started'). It refers to Ty in the third person, so Ty is not its speaker, and no source names the speaker. It is not a confirmed offer, progress or completion line.
78850 is the Lakeshore objective hint: Ty directed the player to speak to several people about stealth.
78848 is the quest objective text: seek out the teachers, then find Chloe in Blackspore.
Ty is the quest giver in Lakeshore (southern Lakeshore) and his quest list includes this quest.

Wiki 'Ninja' page lists Ty as giving this quest and Chloe as giving Strike from the Shadows, so 78855 ('Is your task completed?') belongs to Strike from the Shadows and is not this quest's completion line.
Amateur Ninja Blade was previously acquired from this quest and is no longer obtainable, so it is not a live reward.

open: No client line is confirmed as this quest's offer, progress or complete dialog. 78851 is the closest candidate but has no attributed speaker, so offer is null rather than guessed.
Ty turn-in: the earlier pass's line 90402 ('Return to Ty in Lakeshore') was not verified, and it is not a confirmed step. Not used.

Speaker-to-stop binding is not confirmed by the client lines: Brendan (90423, Seaside), Kosha (90412, Shrouded Glade), Tanda T. Toes (90421, Snowhill) and Chloe (90450, Blackspore) were not re-verified by locale lookup in this pass, so they are not listed as dialog lines.
Stop order is conflicting (record: Brendan, Kosha, Chloe, Ty; guide: Tanda in Snowhill among teachers, Chloe last). Unresolved.
Tanda T. Toes has no bound NPC key; Brendan, Kosha and Chloe keys are reconstructed. Chloe's name locale id not found.
Reward: none confirmed; the 5 coins and 20 XP in the record are unsourced and omitted.
Prerequisite 3110002 (Stolen Away) is an engine gate; the guide places Super Star directly before this quest. Level gate and reachability unknown.
